prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object visible, take object, check properties, move object to storage. If not, scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveToObjectStorage    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Sequence>   <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />   <Action ID = TakeObject    />   <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />   <Action ID = MoveToObjectStorage    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> <Sequence>   <Action ID = MoveToNextObject    />   <Action ID = ScanForObject    /> </Sequence> <Fallback>   <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />   </Sequence>   <Sequence>     <Action ID = MoveToNextObject    />     <Action ID = ScanForObject    />   </Sequence>   <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> </Fallback>"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			SEQUENCE
					IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
					DO TakeObject
			ELSE
				DO CheckObjectProperties
				DO MoveToObjectStorage
			END
	ELSE
		DO ScanAreaForObjects
	END
